name: Spooker
storyline:
It has been a long time since Ralphie had anyone to play with, and his last opponent didn’t last long at all. He’s gonna make sure you play together for a long, long time…

This is pool, but… wrong. Enjoy tight, skill-driven shotmaking, high-risk scoring, and roguelite progression that changes every run and every table. The deeper you go, the more the speakeasy twists and changes. There is always another table, and it keeps getting darker. Will Ralphie ever let you leave?
summary:
A roguelite pool-like game where you play for your freedom against your host and lightly cursed ventriloquist dummy, Ralphie. Steady your shots, build your combos and rack up enough points to make your escape.

This is pool, but… wrong. Enjoy tight, skill-driven shotmaking, high-risk scoring, and roguelite progression that changes every run and every table. The deeper you go, the more the speakeasy twists and changes. There is always another table, and it keeps getting darker. Will Ralphie ever let you leave?
